reason: Stack-exhaustion DoS via deeply nested brace patterns (CWE-674, CVSS 7.5). No patched version exists: the advisory covers every published braces release (<= 3.0.3, first_patched_version null). Reachable only through tailwindcss@3.4.19 -> chokidar/micromatch, and the glob patterns it processes come exclusively from the committed `content` array in tailwind.config.cjs, so no untrusted input can reach it; it is build-time tooling that never ships in the static site. The only upstream escape is leaving Tailwind 3 (Tailwind 4 drops this dependency chain), which is a deliberate migration, not a dependency bump. Expires so this gets re-reviewed rather than forgotten.
